# Allocation repair: standard-library verdict registration

The four tables come from the complete [recording comparison](https://github.com/erniecohen/dafny/actions/runs/37323098742), with product commit `bf55c94fa5df668c2852dc18ecae2bd38a45453b`. Each lane contains all 2,190 declarations and seven project runs. The source library, its contracts and its resource limits are unchanged. Z3 5.1.0 is the fork's solver; Z3 4.12.1 is the separately recorded upstream harness comparator. This recording run is diagnostic evidence. A normal strict run of the final tree is required before merge.

The repair removes the unsound converse from an allocated reads frame to an allocated function, and introduces capture-based allocation at lambda formation. Both change the generated theory and declaration identities or order. The reasons below concern measured solver behavior under those changes; they do not claim that an exhausted proof is false or that every affected proof logically needs an allocation premise.

## Reasons for the changed declarations

The table compares the current result with the complete shipped baseline at `ad1360af0f776c0be6cf57e4f0d38bbdf1ecc365`. OFF and ON mean additional axioms disabled and enabled. Resource counts are declaration totals, not the individual assertion-batch limits.

Current exhaustion is batch 11 at DivMod:1324. The approved pure callback helper is absent from these actual SMT queries. |
| `DivMod.LemmaModNegNeg` | 4.12.1 OFF and ON | OutOfResource → Correct; OFF 1,582,839 → 600,866 RU, ON 1,583,507 → 598,195 RU | The old exhaustion is batch 5 at DivMod:1330. In the OFF diagnostic, restoring the converse restores exhaustion, whereas omitting the pure callback helper preserves every SMT byte and resource count. The solver reacts differently to the repaired theory than 5.1.0. |

Reversing both together restores byte-identical baseline SMT, outcomes and resource counts in both modes. Pure callback omission changes some queries and costs but preserves Correct in both measured modes. The declaration has 257 assertion batches; its higher total does not mean a higher per-batch cap. |

This is the pre-existing repeatability defect tracked in [#30](https://github.com/erniecohen/dafny/issues/30#issuecomment-5987369218), not an attributed benefit of the allocation repair. The four `run Std` rows change only their aggregate counts and reported exhausted locations in accordance with these declaration rows. Target-specific runs are unchanged. The two existing 5.1.0 proof errors remain errors; no proof-error row is accepted as a success.

Five inherited expectations were stale: `DecodeValidPartialsFrom2PaddedSeq` well-formedness is Correct in both modes, `DecodeValidUnpaddedPartialFrom1PaddedSeq` well-formedness is OutOfResource in both modes, and 5.1.0 ON `LemmaModNegNeg` is Correct. The complete current recording and focused controls restore these shipped outcomes.

## Retained diagnostic evidence

- [Paired baseline/current checks](https://github.com/erniecohen/dafny/actions/runs/37324834344): exact compiler and complete library inventories, real Boogie/SMT and assertion records, with unchanged native caps.
- [Individual source interventions](https://github.com/erniecohen/dafny/actions/runs/37326784793) and [remaining-lane checks](https://github.com/erniecohen/dafny/actions/runs/37329071283): converse restoration, lambda-introduction omission and pure callback omission, each measured separately.
- [Combined diagnostic](https://github.com/erniecohen/dafny/actions/runs/37333209680): ten complete calls; the two source reversals are combined only in the diagnostic compiler. No such reversal enters the fix.
- [Arrays ordering replay](https://github.com/erniecohen/dafny/actions/runs/37331955065): six complete calls, including fresh baseline/current repeats and separately labeled nondefault-order comparators. The focused runs use one core, so a full-versus-focused comparison alone does not isolate an ordering cause.

Restoring the known unsound converse is diagnostic evidence only. The final source keeps its removal, capture-based allocation and the owner-approved guarded pure callback consequence. Both parser composition controls verify with that consequence; omitting it fails their composition-equality postconditions. The false-assertion and earlier-heap controls still fail. No standard-library source, proof budget or comparison rule is changed.
